title: Coulomb Force Magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the Coulomb force using Coulomb's law with given charges, distance, and constant.

title: Sphere A Mass
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the mass of sphere A from the equilibrium condition, using the Coulomb force, gravity, and the given angle.

title: Force Diagram Application
description: Important: Applies static equilibrium to sphere A, resolving forces into vertical (tension/weight) and horizontal (Coulomb force) components.

title: Correct Angle Relation
description: Important: Uses the correct trigonometric relation (tan θ = F_coulomb / (mg)) derived from the force balance at 45°.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Demonstrates consistent use of SI units (meters, Newtons, kilograms) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign Handling in Force
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses charge signs when calculating the magnitude of the Coulomb force, or confuses attractive/repulsive nature with magnitude.

title: Trigonometric Error
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect trigonometric function (e.g., sin or cos instead of tan) when relating the Coulomb force to the weight.
